{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the revenue column
print("Revenue dtype:", df_completed['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample values:", df_completed['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for sentinel values (999999.99)
print("Count of sentinel values (999999.99):", (df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
